A '''T-series tactical droid''' was a droid created to serve the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. It was destroyed during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> this [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] commanded a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] supply ship during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]. The ship was supplying the Umbarans, creating hardships for the Republic. The tactical droid was destroyed along with the supply ship when [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|Umbaran starfighters]] commandeered by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] flew into the ship's hangar, and blew up the main reactor.<ref name="Plan of Dissent" />
